title: Clear My Name (Built The Spine)
style: soulful uk garage two-step, 130 bpm, warm Rhodes chords, sub bass with classic UKG wobble, swung snare and shuffled hi-hats, vocal chops on the breakdown, earnest male lead vocal, gospel-tinged backing on the chorus, late-night vindication mood, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the bass, dignified not bitter
lyrics:
[Intro — Rhodes alone, then drums slide in]
I built the spine when the room was dark
Built the brain while they slept on it
Three-three-six in the blueprint

[Verse 1]
They said the things they said when they didn't know me
They said the things they said when they didn't show me
I didn't answer back, I built the answer in code
The answer is the system, the system is the road

[Pre-Chorus]
Quiet wasn't absence, quiet was the floor
The floor held the building, the building knows the score

[Chorus]
Clear my name in the work, not in the noise
Clear my name in the build, not in the voice
Clear my name in the time, not in the chase
Three-three-six in the spine, in its own pace

[Verse 2]
Four years of stack, five years of keel
No PR campaign, just the wood and the steel
The name clears itself when the work walks in
I don't have to argue, I just have to begin

[Chorus]
Clear my name in the work, not in the noise
Clear my name in the build, not in the voice
Clear my name in the time, not in the chase
Three-three-six in the spine, in its own pace

[Bridge]
Built the spine when the room was dark
Built the brain while they slept on it
Built the reach while they made their mark
Now the work walks itself, that's how it'll be lit

[Outro]
Three-three-six on the spine.
Clear.
